releases.name: v2.0.5
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Free the Settings window when it closes by @zolferfigueiredo in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1930
* Add a Terminal option to use the full screen height when the menu bar is hidden by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1934
* Keep the stacked-window list highlight on the window at the front by @MyronKoch in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1938
* Localize the remaining Settings labels for zh-Hans by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1939
* Add a Snap Areas setting for restoring windows resized with Larger or Smaller by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1940
* Skip the title bar double-click action for ignored apps by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1941
* Complete the Spanish (es, es-419) localization by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1942
* Ignore keyboard shortcuts while Mission Control is active by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1935
* Add Hindi (hi) localization by @samanyudas in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1944
* Complete the Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) localization by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1946
* Move thirds and fourths to the adjacent display on repeat by @tlq5l in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1937
* Add a Terminal option to apply an action to every new window by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1945
* Reflow Todo mode when the display configuration changes by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1947
* Fix RectangleTests failing to compile on main by @yannickgloster in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1954
* Keep drag-to-snap on the other displays while a window is fullscreen by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1949
* Keep the Todo window on screen when its app enforces a wider minimum width by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1950
* Support vertical display traversal on repeated half actions by @yannickgloster in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1952
* Add a download and update section for mainland China users to README.zh-Hans.md by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1963
* The `WindowManager` needs to be adjusted so that it can accommodate future changes by @rxhanson in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1967
* Move window to the display under the cursor  by @Kiizon in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1913
* Make the default display ordering deterministic by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1960
* Floor the center third calculations to whole pixels by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1961
* Keep zh-Hans up to date: README sync and translation fixes by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1964
* Give the Todo side its own strings by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1966
* Don't show window size warning on terminal windows unnecessarily by @rxhanson in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1971
* Complete the Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish translations by @zolferfigueiredo in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1957
* Localize tests that fail when not run in English by @rxhanson in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1972
* Add display-aware corner size cycling by @joseph-zhong in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1962
* Complete the Japanese (ja) localization by @poife in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1970
* Cycle vertical sixths through whole sixth, top half and bottom half on repeat by @ehippy in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1968
* Split Rectangle tests into focused files by @rxhanson in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1975

## New Contributors
* @zolferfigueiredo made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1930
* @SamuelAdigos made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1940
* @samanyudas made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1944
* @tlq5l made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1937
* @yannickgloster made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1954
* @Kiizon made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1913
* @joseph-zhong made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1962
* @poife made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1970

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/compare/v2.0.4...v2.0.5

releases.name: v2.0.4
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Keep snap previews translucent with Reduce Transparency by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1898
* Isolate and improve optional window animations by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1886
* Avoid redundant Accessibility writes during ordinary window placement by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1899
* Add mouse button shortcuts for window actions by @harshpatel333 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1895
* Add Persian (fa) localization by @aliafshany in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1910
* Keep snap-preview material and geometry in sync by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1900
* Add an option to snap before reaching outer screen edges by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1901
* Sort the stacked-window list alphabetically by @MyronKoch in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1909
* Persian: fix right-to-left layout of the accessibility prompt by @aliafshany in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1914
* Honor screenEdgeGapTopNotch when it is set to 0 by @efim0v in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1911
* Complete the Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) localization by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1916
* Add regression coverage for Todo placement on offset displays by @culpen90 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1919
* Add full-height vertical sixth window actions by @ehippy in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1917
* Complete the Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) localization by @OCampezzi in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1918
* Ukrainian localization by @lsl87Serhii in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1923
* Add a Simplified Chinese README by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1928
* Add a repeated-commands option that switches to the opposite side by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1925
* Fix drag-snap window detection for Emacs 28 by @culpen90 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1926
* Give Debug builds their own bundle identifier by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1927
* Point README to the 2.0 Settings tabs by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1931
* Use a Chinese screenshot in README.zh-Hans.md by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1936
* Document the alwaysAccountForStage hidden preference by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1932
* Minor bug fixes by @rxhanson 

## New Contributors
* @aliafshany made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1910
* @efim0v made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1911
* @AkiyamaKunka made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1916
* @ehippy made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1917
* @OCampezzi made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1918
* @lsl87Serhii made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1923

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/compare/v2.0.3...v2.0.4
